description_text:
Designed from scratch is a modular shipping container set, high in detail, ideal for scale modeling (currently in 1/24 and 1/25 scale).
Perfect for those dioramas or commercial builds!
The set includes;

  - 2 styles of front door panel assemblies, in open or closed configuration

  - 20 foot side panels and roof panel (note use 2x these pieces to interconnect for a 40 foot panel)

  - 10 foot side panels and roof panels

  - rear piece module

Optional;For those who want to avoid printing the large roof and side panels, tooling has been added to stamp aluminum foil into the same corrugated pattern as the container, including;

  - foil base to lay the foil onto

  - long stamp and short stamp depending on your preference on the stamping method.

Be sure to tag @mattys_custom_scale on Instagram with your finished prints & projects, or see the other MCS resource locations here;
https://linktr.ee/mattys_custom_scale
Intended for personal use, not to be redistributed without consent

description_text:
A Game-Ready Low Poly model of an Abandoned Rusty Tractor .  As the models were primarily made for Mobile/Low Poly Games, the proportions are, in some cases exaggerated and does not pertain to realism in some cases.
Some details about the models: 

  - The total poly count for whole pack is :  113,810 Faces/ 182,645 Vertices

  - Everything is carefully organised

  - All models are made from scratch. No AI or Plugin used. 

  - If you face any issue with the models or see that something is missing, feel free to knock me and I will try my very best to resolve your issue. 

Formats Provided

  - Blend (Assembled Scene File)

  - FBX

  - OBJ

  - Dae

  - USD

Textures Provided

  - PBR 2K

  - PBR 4K

  - Unity 4K

  - Unity 2K

Please Note:

  - Models have mixture of Auto and Manual UV

  - No Interior

  - The wheels are spearated, while the other parts are mostly combined 

  - Main parts are named properly

  - No animation or rigging

  - Renders were done using Marmoset Toolbag 4, Blender And Keyshot wherever needed.

  - Wireframe previews provided

  - The model is not ready for 3D Printing

  - Materials are used

  - The models are mostly low poly meshes.

  - Some of the pivot points might be a bit off. 

  - Original model concept by Fredrick Johansen

If you have any questions or need support, feel free to give me a knock. And if you purchase the model, thank you, really appreciate it  ^_^

description_text:
This Heavy-Duty Modular Construction Ramp Set is a high-quality 3D printable model designed for scale builders, diorama creators, RC hobbyists, and industrial scene makers. The set includes multiple modular ramp sections that can be used individually or combined to create long access ramps, scaffold walkways, or construction platforms.
Each piece is optimized for clean printing, strong structural integrity, and easy assembly. The lightweight lattice-style framework gives a realistic industrial look while minimizing material usage.
Perfect for:

  - Construction site dioramas

  -  RC crawler tracks

  -  Industrial miniature scenes

  -  Scale model displays

  -  Engineering or architectural visualizations

Key Features
Includes multiple ramp modules: short ramps, tall ramps, and extended ladder-style platformsHighly detailed lattice structure for realistic industrial appearanceOptimized for FDM & SLA printingModular design – assemble in different lengths & configurationsHollow internal structure for faster, material-efficient printingFiles included: STL, OBJ, and MAYA (on request)
**3D Print Instructions
For best results:**
Layer Height: 0.2 mm (FDM) / 0.08–0.12 mm (SLA)Infill: 15–20% (Grid or Gyroid)Supports: Not required for most printers (all pieces designed with print-friendly angles)Wall Thickness: Minimum 1.2 mmMaterial: PLA / PETG / ABSPrint Orientation: Flat on the build plate for maximum strength

description_text:
This breathtaking portrait captures the Yamaha R1 superbike in all its high-octane glory a tribute to pure speed, cutting-edge engineering, and the thrill of championship racing. Set against the golden glow of sunset on a professional track, the R1 leans hard into a dramatic banking turn, with motion blur trailing behind to emphasize its explosive velocity.
Every detail of this engineering marvel is meticulously rendered: aggressive aerodynamic fairings, the signature crossplane crankshaft engine gleaming beneath carbon fiber panels, and a bold Yamaha blue-and-white livery that reflects light like liquid metal. Its predator-like LED headlights, ram-air intakes, and carbon-tipped exhaust system evoke power and precision.
The scene includes rich technical realism Bridgestone racing slicks gripping the asphalt, Brembo brake calipers, adjustable suspension, and heat shimmer rolling off the tailpipe. Dust kicks up from the corner, lens flares streak the frame, and sponsor banners stretch above the grandstands to complete the authentic motorsport atmosphere.
This artwork freezes a moment of dominance on the track where design, adrenaline, and raw power converge into one unforgettable image. Perfect for automotive enthusiasts, racers, and fans of mechanical perfection.

TODAY, THE MOST COMMON SCOOTERS ARE MADE OF ALUMINUM, TITANIUM, AND STEEL. THE AUTOPED WAS AN EARLY MOTOR SCOOTER OR MOTORIZED SCOOTER MANUFACTURED BY THE AUTOPED COMPANY OF LONG ISLAND CITY, NEW YORK. THE DRIVER STOOD ON A PLATFORM WITH 10-INCH TIRES AND OPERATED THE MACHINE USING ONLY THE HANDLEBARS AND STEERING COLUMN, PUSHING THEM FORWARD TO ENGAGE THE CLUTCH, USING A LEVER ON THE HANDLEBAR TO CONTROL THE THROTTLE, AND PULLING THE HANDLEBARS AND COLUMN BACK TO DISENGAGE THE CLUTCH AND APPLY THE BRAKE.

description_text:
Prospector Rover Vehicle is a collection of 3D printable files that can be built into a variety of science fiction rover vehicles. They have been designed to print easily and to work with 28-32mm scale figures. The vehicles can be used as terrain for systems like Games Workshop Warhammer 40K and Warhammer 40k Kill Team, Corvus Bellis Infinity, and many other sci-fi and post-apocalyptic games.
Components
Included in Prospector Rover Vehicle are a variety of core components and variant pieces:

  - Prospector Cabin: in two variants.

  - Prospector Body: with working cargo doors, two roof options, and three different rears.

  - Chassis: with 'rocker-bogie' suspension based on real Mars rovers, which includes independently positionable wheels. Also includes three wheel options.

  - A separate, towable trailer that can be added.

  - The parts in this kit also combine with our other Vehicle packs, to add even more variety to your sci-fi tabletop.

Printing
The pieces are designed to be printed on a home FDM 3D printer with:

  - A 0.4mm nozzle.

  - 0.08 - 0.1 mm layer height.

  - 15 - 20% infill.

  - Supports are only required for a few of the .STL files.

  - Rafts may be required for the smaller parts, depending on your 3D printer.

  - The largest part is 90mm long, so this kit can be printed on a 100mm or larger build plate.

All .STL files are oriented correctly so you can load them into your slicer and print immediately. The parts have been designed to print face-up for the best detail. All .STL files were sliced using Cura and test printed on a Creality Ender 3.

Cyberpunk Hover Car is a collection of 3D printable files that build two detailed sci-fi hover/flying vehicles. They have been designed to print easily and to work with 28-32mm scale figures. The vehicle can be used as terrain for systems like Games Workshop Warhammer 40K and Warhammer 40k Kill Team, Corvus Bellis Infinity, Fantasy Flight Star Wars: Legion and many other sci-fi and post-apocalyptic games.
Components
Included in Cyberpunk Hover Car are two cars, with interchangeable parts that can be combined for more variety. A simple flight stand is also provided.
Printing
The pieces are designed to be printed on a home FDM 3D printer with:

  - A 0.4mm nozzle.

  - 0.08 - 0.1 mm layer height.

  - 15 - 20% infill.

  - Supports are only required for a few of the .STL files.

  - Rafts may be required for the smaller parts, depending on your 3D printer.

  - The largest part is 75mm long, so this kit can be printed on a 100mm or larger build plate.

All .STL files are oriented correctly so you can load them into your slicer and print immediately. The parts have been designed to print face-up for the best detail. All .STL files were sliced using Cura and test printed on a Creality Ender 3. Assembly is required.

description_text:
This is a set of brackets used to remove the oem passenger pegs and be able to use the original brake oil reservoir .
I designed and tested various versions of this bracket, some intended to be made in carbon fiber , some in aluminium , some in plastic .every single one is strong enough to work,  but those 5 are the best designs meant to be cnc milled or 3d printed .
this set contains :

  - Bracket classic : , classic race style , easy to print , perfect for cnc milling . intended for cnc milling , will work well if 3d printed 

  - Bracket optimized : perfected with topology optimization , prints with minimal to no support , harder to mill and print than bracket classic but easier then Bracket 3d optimized , a great compromise between the two 

  - Bracket 3d optimized : the most difficult to print /mill , the strongest one . need's support . 

  - Bracket 3d optimized simplified : a cleaner looking Bracket 3d optimized.

  - Bracket carbon fiber : will work if 3d printed , intended to be used to create a mold for composite materials such as carbon fiber .

As a bonus this kit includes the original mesh from the topology optimization , I quite like the organic look but is not ideal to print or use 
petg, abs or better
-Bracket classic - no support -Bracket  optimized - minimal/no support  -Bracket 3d optimized - support -Bracket 3d optimized simplified - support -Bracket carbon fiber - minimal support

description_text:
Roundhouse dimensions:
100mm wide X 100mm long X 35mm tall
Approximate minimum 3D print times for FDM (filament) printing:
Base- 1.5 hrs @ .2 layer heightTop-  7.5 hrs @ .2 layer height w/ support
Note: Print times are approx. to give a general idea of how long the print will take.  It will vary based on individual 3D printers and settings.
Print difficulty: Easy
Description:  We weren't satisfied with the flimsy, boring, plastic octagon normally included with many domino sets for playing Mexican Train.  This stylish train yard roundhouse gives your game night flair and lets your friends and family know they'll need to bring their A-game.
This train-inspired design theme features architectural arches as well as a raised train track which adds realism and allows for easy, multi-color 3D printing with a single color printer (more info below).  It's also sturdy and functional with a platform on top to display the starting game tile and 8 places to store your locomotives or other train markers when not in use.  It's also a fun and unique holiday stocking stuffer, party, or birthday gift!
Unlike many 3D meshes available for downloading and purchase, this model was designed specifically for 3D printing and should be fairly easy for anyone with basic 3D printing experience to print with a standard, desktop FDM printer.  The example in the photos was 3D printed with a Creality Ender 3 using relatively inexpensive, but good quality PLA filament and typical, standard settings.  Other methods of 3D printing should work equally well.
What you get: Two (2) downloadable 3D mesh STL files, one for the top, and one for the bottom, that form the central game piece for playing Mexican Train when joined together.  STL files for other game pieces are not included.  
3D printing suggestions and comments:  For FDM style printing, PLA filament is recommended because it's easy to print with, and when printed properly, it will create a strong game piece that should last a very long time when used under normal conditions.  Almost any popular filament type (ABS, PLA, PTEG, etc.) will work, but PLA is more than adequate and usually easiest to use.  You will also have the most color choices with PLA.
A layer height of 0.2mm is recommended for a good balance of detail and print time, but any layer height from 0.1mm to 0.3mm should yield acceptable results.  It is also recommended that you print both parts separately in their upright, default orientation.  The top part will need supports for the arches.  The bottom part may need a brim to prevent warping during printing.  After printing, the two parts are designed to snap together and hold without glue, but glue may be used if needed.   A properly calibrated 3D printer and a good print quality will ensure the best fit!  YouTube is a good source for videos on printer calibration.
Multi-color 3D printing:  It's convenient to 3D print this model in multiple colors with a small, simple, single-color FDM-style 3D printer.  As well as printing the top and bottom pieces in two different colors, when printing the bottom piece you may change filament color at a layer height of 1.6mm, adding an accent to the train tracks as seen in the example image.  If you want to go further, change filament color at both 1.6mm and 2.0mm layer heights so that the base, railroad ties, and the train track are three different colors (not pictured).  Contrasting, wild colors  are recommended.  Remember, this is for FUN!!! :-)

description_text:
Mounting Bracket designed to fit a NE555 Timer Relay.
I have several of these on my model railway and mounting isn't easy so I have designed a mounting bracket that can be used with these devices.
The bracket comes as a single bracket or multiple brackets connected.
Mounting holes in the bracket for attaching NE555 is 2mm in diameter and recommend attaching ne555 with 2.2mm diameter 6mm long self-tapping screw (these can be bought on eBay).Bracket mounting holes are 4.3mm in diameter so standard 4mm screws can be used, alternatively, a nut and bolt could be used.
These have been designed to be printed on a Resin or Filament 3D Printer.An example is printed on a AnyCubic Photon Resin Printer
What is a NE555 relay? NE555 12V Delay Timer Monostable Switch Adjustable Relay Module Description:

  - Brand new and professional high-quality delay switch module

  - With power indicator LED and trigger indication LED

  - Output is voltage-free & can be connected up to a 10A load of any voltage rating

  - Chrono-potentiometer regulation time delay, adjustable from 0 to 10 seconds by default

  - Useful for applications in equipment delay to prevent sudden high currents which can burn components and devices

You can purchase a pack of 5 NE555 relays with my Amazon Associate Link https://amzn.to/3YZmhDo

description_text:
This is a full 3D Printable working quadcopter frame that will support most electronics!
The quadcopter is 28.5" from Boom tip to Boom tip, and the main body is 1" thick and 7" wide, while the Booms are all .5" x 2". All of the Booms Lean inward at a ten Degree angle, this reduces prop wash (shaking while descending) and increases aerodynamics! I Also added another body that you can download, this is for all of the people that enjoy having the versatility of a frame that can convert from an X style directly into an DeadCat style frame! You Can download what you like the most! Just to let the people know who are not familiar with the DeadCat frame style, the front two booms are wider apart, while the back 2 booms remain at a 90 Degree angle. This makes better for filming because you do not get the booms in the picture! Most flight controllers also support this frame style as well! I just added Some Landing Gear for the copter that should be pretty strong, and will sit the copter 8" off the ground. This is perfect for carrying gimbals, or just for the person that doesn't want their quad sitting on the ground! There are two versions of landing gear that you can print, the larger landing gear is better for the people who are looking for an aerial photography platform, while the smaller landing gear is better for people who have sport style copters. The small landing gear sits the copter around 3.5 inches off of the ground. BTW I recommend that you print this out of ABS, but PLA will work. Please download, print, and fly! Thanks :) PS: If you have any questions you can contact me through my email- FlightFixit@gmail.com

Water roads link the city parts. On the green rooftops of the apartment houses there are bicycle lanes and private and public gardens. Many towers are equipped with algae tanks, the algae are collected to be used as biomass in reactors. All houses are made out of recycleable materials. description_text:
Gym equipment cyclette 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 23931 vertices, 23839 quad faces (47678 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
This is a 3D model of stationary spinning bicycle which is made with help of blender 2.79.This model requires Blender 2.79 or latter version because of the use of new PBR shader Principled BDSFThis model contains UV's that are minimally stretched(last four images contain four parts i.e. Handle Controller , Wheel&Paddle Controller , Seat Controller , Base Frame Controller).

  - Model at real world scale (meter unit) 

  - 4 controllers included in the scene : Handle Controller , Wheel and Paddle Controller , Seat Controller , Base Frame Controller            Handle Controller(handle bar,handle adjust knob,computer system,handlebar adjustment knob)            Wheel and Paddle Controller(flywheel,left paddle,right paddle,crank arm)            Seat Controller(seat,seat supporter,seat position adjust knob,height adjust knob,seat tube)             Base Frame Controller(water bottle handler,anti-slip fcoting,adjustable restistance,top tube,down tube)

  - Internal mechanism is not modeled

GEOMETRY

  - Subdividable geometry with only quads

  - Handle Controller , Wheel and Paddle Controller , Seat Controller , Base Frame Controller are smoothed with Subdivision Surface Modifier Level 2 in Blender

  - 34511 polygons(LOW POLY) :                                                            Vertices        Polygons    Handle Controller                     5222               5114
Wheel and Paddle Controller      18262               18084
   Seat Controller                           5832               5818    Base Frame Controller            5572               5494

RENDERERS/RENDERING

  - Cycles Render is used with Blender 2.79

  - Models Blender (Cycles) with their materials and textures mapped are ready to render

  - Thumbnails rendered with Cycles Render

  - SAME RENDERING APPEARANCE AS PREVIEWS (Dark Background)

  - First rendering exactly the same as first dark background thumbnail

UVs

  - All objects are UV Mapped (Unwrapped UVs are MIXED type i.e. same objects are overlapped and differnt objects are seperated)

  - Complete object uv are in four island (i)Handle Controller Island (i)Wheel and Paddle Controller Island (iii)Seat Controller Island (iv)Base Frame Controller Island

  - All Islands UV's are minimally stretched(stretching can be identified using color of island i.e. blue.....to.....red means minimum stretching.....to.....maximum stretching)

FORMATS

  - FBX    - fbx format (7.4 binary) from Blender 2.79    - contains low poly subdividable geometry compatible with 3ds Max or Maya MeshSmooth modifier. Some textures should be reassigned    - Textures includes in the textures.zip file

  - OBJ    - .obj format from Blender 2.79 to maximize compatibility with 3ds Max     - contain low poly subdividable geometry compatible with 3ds Max or Maya MeshSmooth modifier. Some textures should be reassigned    - Textures includes in the textures.zip file

  - BLEND     - .blend format from Blender 2.79    - contain high poly subdividable geometry     - Textures are packed withing .blend file and also included in textures.zip file

  - Other Formats(LOW POLY)    - .abc    - .x3d/.wrl    - .dae    - .ply    - .stl

TEXTURES/MATERIAL
  - Contains 6 images (i)spinning-text-logo black (ii)spinning-text-logo orange (iii)ryf logo (iv)normal map for seat (v)reading details (vi)spinning-logo grey

description_text:
Inverted U bicycle rack 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 23242 vertices, 23224 quad faces (46448 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

A low poly bike rack created in Softimage, textured in Substance Painter, and rendered in Keyshot. Made with Unity in mind, but should be fine for any platform that will accept .fbx or .obj
-Game Ready.
-Textures are in 4k, 2k, 1k, and include Albedo Transparency, Metallic Smooth, Ambient Occlusion, and Normal.
-Model has no N-gons, only Quads and Tris, is positioned at the origin [0, 0, 0], has no visible seams or obvious UV stretching, contains no isolated vertices, no coincident vertices or any coincident faces.
-File formats .obj, .fbx, .ksp, and .unitypackage (Unity Package) included.
-Unity package complete with prefabs (just drag into your scene and the materials and textures are already applied. Different LOD's are set to corresponding texture sizes).
-Low poly objects for maximum engine efficiency and compatibility.
-Always priced competitively and reasonable.

description_text: An Exercise Bike is a Stationary bicycle, it is a device used as exercise equipment for indoor cycling. It includes a saddle, pedals, and some form of handlebars arranged as on a bicycle. Exercise bikes are stationary bicycles that are used for increasing general fitness, the two most important exercise bikes use either a friction mechanism as their resistance mechanism or a magnet mechanism as their resistance mechanism. The friction mechanism work like the brake pads of a normal bicycle, the more you press the pads together the more the resistance increase and the byproduct is more intensive exercise sessions, While the magnet mechanism work by replacing the normal bicycle wheel with a ferromagnetic cylinder wheel and a magnet hanging on top, the more you move your magnet closer to the cylinder wheel the more the wheel will resist spinning resulting to a more intensive exercise. I decided to design the exercise bike with magnet mechanism because it requires less maintenance.

description_text:
Here's an overview of the key components and features of hydraulic disc brakes on bicycles:
Brake Caliper:
The brake caliper houses the brake pads and is responsible for squeezing them against the brake rotor to create friction and slow down the bike.There are usually two pistons within the caliper that move when the brake lever is squeezed.Brake Rotor:
The brake rotor is a metal disc attached to the wheel hub. When the brake caliper squeezes the brake pads against the rotor, it creates friction, resulting in the bike coming to a stop.Rotors come in various sizes, and larger rotors generally provide more stopping power.Brake Lever:
The brake lever is the component on the handlebars that the rider squeezes to activate the brake system.In hydraulic disc brakes, the lever is connected to the brake caliper by a hydraulic line filled with brake fluid.Hydraulic Fluid:
Hydraulic disc brakes use brake fluid (usually mineral oil or DOT fluid) to transmit force from the brake lever to the caliper.The fluid is housed in a sealed system, and when the brake lever is squeezed, it compresses the fluid, causing the pistons in the caliper to move and press the brake pads against the rotor.Master Cylinder:
The master cylinder is part of the brake lever assembly and contains a reservoir for brake fluid.When the brake lever is activated, the master cylinder regulates the flow of hydraulic fluid to apply the appropriate amount of pressure on the brake caliper.Hoses:
Hydraulic hoses connect the master cylinder to the brake caliper, allowing the transmission of hydraulic fluid between the two.These hoses are typically made of reinforced materials to withstand high pressures.Advantages of Hydraulic Disc Brakes:
Increased Stopping Power: Hydraulic disc brakes provide excellent stopping power, especially in wet or muddy conditions.
Modulation: Riders can easily control the amount of braking force applied, allowing for precise modulation.
Less Effort: Hydraulic brakes require less finger effort at the brake lever compared to mechanical disc brakes.
Consistent Performance: They are less affected by cable stretch, providing more consistent performance over time.
Self-Adjusting: As the brake pads wear, hydraulic disc brakes are often self-adjusting, maintaining consistent performance.
It's important to note that hydraulic disc brakes may require specialized tools and knowledge for maintenance and repair. If you're unfamiliar with bicycle brake systems, it's advisable to seek assistance from a professional bike mechanic when dealing with hydraulic brakes.

description_text:
A bicycle handlebar with integrated gear shifters is commonly known as a combination or integrated shifter. These handlebars are designed to incorporate the gear shifters directly into the handlebar setup. There are a few common types:
Drop Bars with Integrated Shifters:
Drop handlebars are often found on road bikes. Some road bike models come with integrated shifters, commonly known as STI (Shimano Total Integration) or DoubleTap (for SRAM).These shifters are located on the brake levers, allowing the rider to shift gears without moving their hands from the brake hoods or drops.Flat Bars with Integrated Shifters:
Flat handlebars, commonly found on mountain bikes and hybrid bikes, can also have integrated shifters.Integrated shifters for flat bars are often referred to as trigger shifters or Rapidfire shifters. They are mounted on the handlebar and can be operated with the thumb or index finger.Twist Grip Shifters:
Twist grip shifters are another type of integrated shifter, where the gear shifting mechanism is integrated into the handlebar grips.By twisting the grip, the rider can shift gears without taking their hands off the handlebars.Bullhorns with Integrated Shifters:
Bullhorn handlebars, which have a straight middle section and forward-curving extensions, can also be equipped with integrated shifters.The placement of these shifters may vary, but they are designed for easy access while riding in the bullhorn position.The choice of handlebar with integrated shifters often depends on the type of bike and the rider's preferences. Road bikes tend to have drop bars with integrated shifters for a more aerodynamic riding position, while mountain bikes and hybrid bikes might have flat bars or bullhorns with integrated shifters for a more upright riding position.

description_text:
Introducing our innovative DIY Chain Guard, a creative blend of functionality and repurposed cycling components. Crafted from a robust large chain ring and a sturdy pedal, this chain guard offers both protection and a distinctive aesthetic for your bicycle.
Key Features:
Upcycled Design: Embrace sustainability with our upcycled chain guard, repurposed from a large chain ring and pedal. By giving these components a new life, you contribute to eco-friendly cycling accessories.
Durable Construction: The large chain ring provides a solid foundation, ensuring durability and resistance to wear. The robust pedal acts as a protective shield, safeguarding your bike chain from dirt, debris, and potential snags.
Easy Installation: Designed for hassle-free installation, the DIY Chain Guard can be easily attached to your bike frame. The simplicity of the design allows for quick adjustments and customization, making it accessible for all skill levels.
Customizable Aesthetics: Personalize your ride with a chain guard that goes beyond functionality. The combination of the large chain ring and pedal creates a unique and eye-catching visual appeal, adding a touch of individuality to your bicycle.
Universal Fit: Our DIY Chain Guard is adaptable to various bike models, providing a universal fit for a wide range of frames. Whether you ride a road bike, mountain bike, or cruiser, enjoy the added protection without compromising style.
Reduced Chain Noise: Experience a quieter ride with the added benefit of reduced chain noise. The chain guard dampens vibrations and minimizes contact with the chain, enhancing your overall cycling experience.
Low Maintenance: The DIY Chain Guard requires minimal maintenance, allowing you to focus on the joy of cycling. Simply wipe it down as needed to keep your bike looking sleek and well-protected.
Upgrade your bicycle with our DIY Chain Guard, a sustainable and stylish solution that brings together form and function in a truly distinctive way. Ride confidently, knowing your chain is shielded by a one-of-a-kind accessory that reflects your commitment to creativity and eco-conscious cycling.

description_text:
This adapter/bracket supports 1-⅝” channel to create an attractive installation on any car with existing rails or truck bed interior.
I installed it as a bicycle rack on my 2018 Ford Ecosport by using the provided 6mm screw holes in the vehicle rails. 
If your existing car rails are purely cosmetic you can drill holes and use ¼” self tapping screws.The bracket has room to drill additional holes for a custom fit.   Other than the 6mm screw I used to attach to my roof rails,  everything is 1//4”-20 by 1” long for supporting the brackets to the unistrut.
Also I have provided some optional Caveman badging that can be used.   Due to these brackets being universal.  The badging location may vary so the badging will have to be glued in the location you choose.
Installation Instructions”
1) Print the brackets in either PETG or TPU with a 50+% infill.  If you have slight angles to your existing rails TPU makes a good solid mounting while        giving just a little flex for 1 or two degrees.  Also TPU offers a kind of buffering for the cargo.
2 )Install brackets and measure the distance between the interior of the bracket where the channel sits.   Remember to measure twice, cut once.  
3) Install the 1-⅝” channel to the brackets using the ¼” hardware described above.  Use was flat washers and lock washers.
Tips:

  -  Purchase #14 gauge unistrut.  #12 gauge is too heavy and overkill.

  -  If youre using as a bike rack, see the attached Amazon fork mount I purchased.

  -  The mounting bracket has a small cavity for holding the ¼” nut.  This makes the     installation much easier.

Painting the strut prior to installation gives a really good look.  I would say semi gloss black or grey are both fantastic.  Maybe even Red.

High-Quality Realistic Bicycle Disc Brake Rotor - Factory Clean EditionProduct OverviewElevate your 3D scenes with this high-fidelity, meticulously detailed bicycle disc brake rotor. This model is a perfect representation of a modern 160mm MTB rotor, often found on high-performance bikes like the ST120 series. Whether you are working on a first-person shooter where the player interacts closely with the bike, a high-end architectural visualization of a modern garage, or a product advertisement, this asset provides the professional quality you need. It has been carefully optimized from a high-poly sculpt to ensure every cooling hole and mechanical bevel looks crisp while maintaining a performance-friendly footprint.
Technical Excellence & OptimizationAs a professional 3D instructor and artist, I understand the importance of clean geometry. This asset has been reduced from its original high-density mesh to an optimized ~96k faces, specifically targeted for Hero Object status. This means you get cinematic-level detail without unnecessary system strain. The topology is quad-dominant, ensuring flawless shading even under the harshest lighting conditions.
Advanced PBR TexturingThe model utilizes a full PBR (Physically Based Rendering) workflow. The textures are provided in 4K resolution to capture every nuance of the brushed stainless steel finish. Using Substance Painter, I have recreated the iconic circular machining marks and micro-scratches that define a real-world rotor. The metallic and roughness maps are finely tuned to ensure the surface reacts naturally to different lighting environments, from bright outdoor sunlight to dim indoor workshop lamps.
Key Specifications:
Optimization: Game-Ready and cinematic-ready.
Geometry: Clean topology, optimized for Unreal Engine (Nanite compatible).
Texture Maps: Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, Normal, and Ambient Occlusion (2048x2048px).
Real-World Scale: Precisely modeled after real 160mm bicycle components.
Compatibility: Seamless integration into Unreal Engine 5, Unity, Blender, and Maya.
Support and UpdatesWhen you purchase this asset, you are not just getting a 3D model; you are getting a production-standard tool. I am committed to providing the best assets for the community. If you have any technical questions or need specific export formats, please feel free to contact me.

Ultimate Bicycle Disc Brake Rotor Bundle - Clean & Rusty PBR EditionProduct Overview: Two Styles, One Master PackWhy settle for one look when you can have the complete lifecycle of a mechanical asset? This Ultimate Bundle features two high-fidelity, production-standard 160mm bicycle disc brake rotors: the Factory Clean Edition and the Abandoned Rusty Edition. Modeled after the iconic ST120 MTB series, these assets are designed for professional developers who demand both aesthetic versatility and technical precision. Whether your project is a high-end architectural visualization requiring a pristine workshop look or a gritty post-apocalyptic survival game needing weathered environmental storytelling, this bundle provides the perfect solution in a single, cost-effective package.
Technical Mastery & OptimizationAs a dedicated 3D artist and instructor, I prioritize the balance between visual wow-factor and engine performance. Both models in this bundle have undergone a rigorous optimization process, evolving from high-density 317k tris sculpts into clean, quad-dominant ~96k face meshes. This ensures they maintain Hero Object status—looking flawless in extreme close-ups—while remaining fully compatible with modern technologies like Unreal Engine 5’s Nanite system. The topology has been meticulously checked to ensure zero shading artifacts, providing a professional-grade experience for any pipeline.

The Clean Version showcases a realistic brushed stainless steel finish with circular machining marks, capturing the essence of a brand-new component.
The Rusty Version utilizes advanced masking in Substance Painter to simulate deep oxidation, realistic corrosion, and environmental wear, telling a silent story of neglect and age.With these two variations, you can easily implement item degradation systems in your games or simply choose the version that best fits your scene’s mood.
Key Bundle Specifications:
Total Assets: 2 Distinct Rotor Variations (Clean & Rusty).
Geometry: Optimized ~96k Faces per model, Quad-dominant, clean UVs.
Textures: 4K Resolution PBR (Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, Normal, AO).
Formats: FBX, OBJ, and native Blend files included.
Compatibility: Engine-ready for UE5, Unity, and all major DCC software (Blender, Maya, 3ds Max).
Scale: Accurate real-world 160mm dimensions.

description_text:
Eddie Mauro™. Inti electric bus concept. 2012. Product and car design. Original file created in Autodesk Inventor. Interior seats are not included. Inti (Inca sun god) is a solar, urban / suburban electric bus. It was proposed for the master plan mobility and SITP in the form of inter-municipal transportation in the metropolitan area of Bogotá, in addition to possible uses within groups of complementary and urban buses. It was also proposed as an alternative a system of fair pay in which it was paid by the distance traveled by the passenger. Was focused in different topics of bus design such as: accessibility, lighting, indoor temperature, chairs, chairs organization and the atmosphere and interior appearance of the vehicle. All this adapted to the proposed payment system.
This is just the station of Inti Bus.
Team work with Crystian Hoyos.
More info here: https://www.behance.net/gallery/4955183/Inti-Electric-Solar-bus

description_text:
I created this 3D model with all my heart because right now my family desperately needs help.
My beloved wife was hit by a bus and suffered very severe injuries. For many days her life was hanging by a thread – it was extremely close that we would lose her. I used up every single euro of our savings and even took out loans to cover the emergency operations and intensive care that ultimately saved her life.
Thank God, she is still with us today. She survived. But the long road of recovery and rehabilitation is only just beginning – and I have nothing left financially.All my reserves are gone, and new medical costs for physio, medication, special therapy and follow-up treatment keep coming. Without support we simply cannot manage the coming months.That’s why I’m humbly asking:If you like this little 3D model and/or if you feel moved to help, even a small donation would mean the world to us right now. Every euro helps bring my wife one step closer to walking again and returning to our life together.From the bottom of my heart – may God bless you and your loved ones abundantly. Thank you for any kindness you can show us in this very hard time.With gratitude,Elvijs Landmans

Complete with detailed interior: driver bench seat with lever shift,passenger bench seats facing each other along both sides, hanging strapsfor standing passengers, fare box near driver, rear-view mirrors,dashboard with period-correct gauges.
Exterior wear: faded yellow paint with chips at edges, rust at bumper andwheel arches, scratched side panels, worn tire tread, weathered decals,dust on roof — authentic daily-workhorse condition.
TRUE ISOMETRIC reference renders included.

FEATURES:

  - Complete vehicle: exterior + interior + chassis + wheels

description_text:
Car wheel rim 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 63482 vertices, 63520 quad faces (127040 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text: A railroad crane (North America: crane car or wrecker; UK: breakdown crane) is a type of crane used on a railroad for one of three primary purposes: freight handling in goods yards, permanent way (PW) maintenance, and accident recovery work. Although the design differs according to the type of work, the basic configuration is similar in all cases: a rotating crane body is mounted on a sturdy chassis fitted with flanged wheels. The body supports the jib (UK; North America: boom) and provides all the lifting and operating mechanisms; on larger cranes, an operator's cabin is usually provided. The chassis is fitted with buffing (UK) and/or coupling gear to allow the crane to be moved by a locomotive, although many are also self-propelled to allow limited movement about a work site.

description_text: The mecanum wheel is an omnidirectional wheel design for a land-based vehicle to move in any direction. It is sometimes called the Swedish wheel or Ilon wheel after its inventor, Bengt Erland Ilon (1923-2008), who conceived of the concept while working as an engineer with the Swedish company Mecanum AB, and patented it in the United States on November 13, 1972.The mecanum wheel is a form of tireless wheel, with a series of rubberized external rollers obliquely attached to the whole circumference of its rim. These rollers typically each have an axis of rotation at 45° to the wheel plane and at 45° to the axle line. Each Mecanum wheel is an independent non-steering drive wheel with its own powertrain, and when spinning generates a propelling force perpendicular to the roller axle, which can be vectored into a longitudinal and a transverse component in relation to the vehicle.

description_text: The mecanum wheel is an omnidirectional wheel design for a land-based vehicle to move in any direction. It is sometimes called the Swedish wheel. The mecanum wheel is a form of tireless wheel, with a series of rubberized external rollers obliquely attached to the whole circumference of its rim. These rollers typically each have an axis of rotation at 45° to the wheel plane and at 45° to the axle line. Each Mecanum wheel is an independent non-steering drive wheel with its own powertrain, and when spinning generates a propelling force perpendicular to the roller axle, which can be vectored into a longitudinal and a transverse component in relation to the vehicle.

description_text: The Scania PRT-range (also known as Scania LPGRS-range or Scania PGRT-range),[1] also referred to as new truck range or Scania's truck range, is the current range of trucks produced by the Swedish commercial vehicle manufacturer Scania. It was first introduced as the successor to the 4-series in spring 2004 with the high forward control cab Scania R-series, followed by the low forward control cab Scania P-series and bonneted cab Scania T-series later in the year. The bonneted model was discontinued in 2005. In 2007 the Scania G-series, a medium forward control cab was introduced and was derived from the R-series. The entire range is modular, giving a wide range of different configurations for different types of trucks. The trucks are available with engines ranging from a 9-litre I5 to a 16-litre V8, with the V8 only being available in the higher model. A second generation launched in August 2016, first was the Scania S-series being the first flat-floor model. In December 2017, a low-end version of the second generation, the Scania L-series, also launched.

description_text:
The word Jeriken comes from the English word , Jerrycan. The word Jerrycan is a combination of the words Jerry and Can. Jerry /ˈdʒɛri/ is the pejorative form of the German word and Can /kən/ means can . The word Jerry was used to refer to Germans in the military field.
A jerry can (or jerry can ) is a closed container that holds liquid and has a handle so it can be moved. According to the Big Indonesian Dictionary , a jerry can is a container usually containing 20 liters , made of metal or plastic , rectangular in shape, flat and with a narrow head. In the past, jerry cans were used as fuel containers made of pressed iron . The jerry can design was made in Germany in the 1930s which was used as fuel storage for needsmilitary with a capacity of 20 liters. Technological developments have caused the material for making jerry cans to use plastic. Generally, a tool called a funnel is used to fill the jerry cans , so that in the process of pouring liquid into the jerry cans the liquid will not spill. Jeriken is useful as a container for holding relatively large amounts of liquids such as fuel, water , and so on.

description_text: A differential is a gear train with three drive shafts that have the property that the rotational speed of one shaft is the average of the speeds of the others. A common use of differentials is in motor vehicles, to allow the wheels at each end of a drive axle to rotate at different speeds while cornering. A differential is used to distribute the torque at a 900 angle that was coming from the propeller shaft and send the torque to the wheels, the differential is made of several parts including; the pinion gear, sun gears, ring gear (grown gear) and a spider gear (planet pinion). During cornering, the outer wheels of a vehicle must travel further than the inner wheels (since they are in a larger radius). This is easily accommodated when the wheels are not connected; however, it becomes more difficult for the drive wheels, since both wheels are connected to the engine (usually via a transmission). Some vehicles (for example go-karts and trams) use axles without a differential, thus relying on wheel slip when cornering. However, for improved cornering abilities, many vehicles use a differential, which allows the two wheels to rotate at different speeds. The purpose of a differential is to transfer the engine's power to the wheels while still allowing the wheels to rotate at different speeds when required.

Anti-aircraft (AA) guns, also known as anti-aircraft artillery, are weapons designed to engage and destroy hostile aircraft. These guns come in various sizes, types, and configurations depending on the intended use, the threat they are designed to counter, and the era in which they were developed. Here's a general description of AA guns:
Purpose: AA guns are primarily used for defense against aerial threats, including enemy aircraft, helicopters, drones, and sometimes even missiles. They are typically deployed to protect military installations, ships, convoys, and other high-value assets from airborne attacks.
Types: AA guns can be classified based on various criteria such as caliber, firing mechanism, mobility, and purpose. Some common types include:
Heavy AA guns: These are large-caliber guns mounted on stationary or mobile platforms. They are capable of engaging high-flying or heavily armored targets.Medium AA guns: These guns usually have a smaller caliber than heavy AA guns and are more mobile. They are effective against medium-altitude threats.Light AA guns: Smaller caliber guns, often mounted on vehicles or used as portable infantry weapons. They are employed against low-flying aircraft, helicopters, and ground targets.Automatic AA guns: Rapid-firing guns capable of engaging multiple targets quickly. They are often used for close-range defense against aircraft and drones.Caliber and Ammunition: AA guns can range from small-caliber machine guns to large-caliber cannons. The caliber determines the effectiveness against different types of aircraft and the range at which they can engage targets. Ammunition for AA guns can include explosive shells, tracer rounds, and armor-piercing projectiles.
Fire Control Systems: Modern AA guns are often equipped with sophisticated fire control systems, including radar, tracking systems, and computerized aiming mechanisms. These systems enhance accuracy and allow for effective engagement of fast-moving aerial targets.
Mobility: Depending on the intended use, AA guns can be mounted on various platforms such as stationary emplacements, towed trailers, trucks, armored vehicles, ships, and aircraft. Mobile AA guns provide flexibility and can be rapidly deployed to areas under threat.
Countermeasures: AA guns may be equipped with countermeasures such as flak bursts, smoke screens, and decoy systems to confuse or deter enemy aircraft and missiles.
Overall, AA guns play a crucial role in air defense strategies, providing a last line of defense against aerial threats and contributing to the protection of military forces and critical infrastructure.

description_text:
Intended for 3d print.
British armoured road and off-road train, used (sparingly) during the Second Boer War 1899-1902. The British Empire suffered logistical problems in the war, as the terrain in South Africa was difficult. Boer kommandos would raid vulnerable supply lines and evade reprisals. To combat this, the British commander Lord Roberts commissioned Fowler & Co in Leeds to build 6 armoured traction engines, along with 3 armoured wagons for each engine. The idea was to make the british supply lines less reliant on vulnerable rail lines, and make their convoys able to defend themselves against Boer raiding parties. The Fowler B5 Armoured Road Train could drive on regular roads, or even off-road to some extent assuming the terrain wasn't too hilly or forested. The armour - provided by Cammell Laird & Co - on the locomotive and wagons could withstand small-arms fire, while the wagons could carry soldiers and small cannons for defense. The locomotive was steam-powered and thus only required access to water and cheap fuel sources like wood, coke, coal or even dried dung for continued operation. The road train was slow by modern standards, capable of only up to 6 mph on flat surface.
The armoured wagons were generally open-roofed to provide air for passengers. But if needed, the side plates of the wagons could be folded inwards and down to provide a low, sloping roof for the wagon. Note that this version of the wagon is NOT included in this kit - instead there is a more conventional wagon with a high roof. In their standard configuration, the side plates had loopholes for passengers to see and shoot out of. Field guns could be stored inside the wagons, or towed by the train.
Of the six armoured trains ordered, four were ultimately delivered. By the time the Fowler B5 Armoured Road Trains reached South Africa, they were no longer required in their armoured form and was stripped of their plating.
What this kit includes
This kit includes a locomotive, four wagons and a Maxim machine gun. Note that there are several different versions of these parts included, detailed below.

  - Locomotive, 28mm version. The locomotive and rear wheels are printed separately, and then assembled post-print. There is a locomotive version with fixed front wheels, and a locomotive versions with the front wheels printed separately. The version with fixed front wheels have steering chains attached, while the one with front wheels printed separately does not have steering chains but can turn the wheels left and right.

  - Armoured wagon with armoured roof, 28mm version. The wagon has coupling which can attach to either the locomotive or other wagons, to form a train. 

  - Armoured wagon without armoured roof, 28mm version. Like above, but without roof.

  - Armoured wagon without armoured roof and with open back doors, 28mm version. Like above, but also with its back doors opened. Troops and guns can be placed inside.

  - Armoured wagon without roof or side plates, 28mm version. A more traditional open wagon which can carry troops, guns, or even goods.

  - Locomotive, 6mm version. A reinforced version of the locomotive, for printing at smaller scales. The model prints as one piece, with no post-print assembly required.

  - Armoured wagons, 6mm versions. Reinforced versions of all 4 wagons, for printing at smaller scales.

  - Maxim Gun. The Maxim gun was originally released as an entirely separate kit, and includes many variants. There is a version on a wheeled mount, a version on a tripod, a version without mount et cetera. The Maxim guns can be used with their mounts/tripods, or attached to the locomotive and wagons as gun emplacements. See image gallery for a couple of examples. Note that I generally don't recommend that the Maxim guns be printed at sub-28mm scale.

description_text:
A centrifugal pump is a mechanical device designed to move fluid by means of the transfer of rotational energy from one or more driven rotors, called impellers. Fluid enters the rapidly rotating impeller along its axis and is cast out by centrifugal force along its circumference through the impeller’s vane tips.  The action of the impeller increases the fluid’s velocity and pressure and also directs it towards the pump outlet.  The pump casing is specially designed to constrict the fluid from the pump inlet, direct it into the impeller and then slow and control the fluid before discharge.
This centrifugal pump is designed by Solidworks 2022 and contains 15 rendering pictures and all Solidworks parts and assembly files.

Neo descubre entonces que debe escoger, entre la salvación de Zion, o la de Trinity, decantándose por esta segunda opción. Mientras Trinity cae desde la cristalera de un edificio, justo como en sus pesadillas, Neo logra salvarla de caer al vacío. Tras eso, les confiesa a todos que no es el Elegido.

description_text: 3D MODEL DESCRIPTIONThis is a model of an old motorcycle with a sidecar , when the rod is pressed downwards, a pushing arm rises upwards and takes out a toothpick while opening the doors of the sidecar .There are two models - one very detailed in which each part of the motorcycle is separate (to be honest it was a bit challenging to print and paste all these small parts).The second model The entire body of the motorcycle is a single unit, i Divided the body in half vertically so that printing is easy without much support and then gluing the two halves together, and it remains to glue together the body of the motorcycle to the sidecar , wheels, chair, and doors.There is room for a small rubber band at the bottom between the lifting arm and the body of the side car , (there are two holes where a small nail needs to be inserted and the rubber band is caught on them to make sure the lifting arm go oll the way down ,can work with out the rubber also ,).I used small nails with a diameter of 1.2 mm and pins of various sizes as hinges for doors, and reinforcement in the front fork and as decoration in places where there should be a hinge.If there are any questions I will be happy to help,

description_text:
A motorcycle's suspension serves a dual purpose: contributing to the vehicle's handling and braking, and providing safety and comfort by keeping the vehicle's passengers comfortably isolated from road noise, bumps and vibrations.
The typical motorcycle has a pair of fork tubes for the front suspension, and a swingarm with one or two shock absorbers for the rear suspension.The most common form of front suspension for a modern motorcycle is the telescopic fork. Other fork designs are girder forks, suspended on sprung parallel links (not common since the 1940s) and bottom leading link designs, not common since the 1960s.
Vincent Black Lightning with Girdraulic front suspensionSome manufacturers (e.g. Greeves) used a version of the swinging arm for front suspension on their motocross designs. A single-sided version of the idea is also used in motor scooters such as the Vespa.
The hub-center steering as developed by Ascanio Rodorigo, on a concept associated to Massimo Tamburini is a complex front swingarm alternative system that entails suspension and steering, as seen in projects such as Bimota Tesi and Vyrus motorcycles.

description_text:
Speaker inclosure I used on my Harley Road Glide 2009, fit the Harley Davidson lower fearing.
Different models are available in my profile.
I can create custom grills on demand, more expensive tho.
Should fit most 5.25 speaker with the legs (they have ether legs or are fully rounded).
Easy to print, doesn't require a big format printer. I printed mine on a old Replicator from 2012, so nowadays any printer can print that easely. The enclosure was also simplifyed for abs moulding.
I suggets using PETG or ABS if you can, and with ABS you can acetone-smooth the surface to make it look even better.
My usual print setting for PETG are : 3 outline perimeters, 3 top and bottom layers, 50% infill at a minimum.
As always, if there is demand on one of my models I will update it and make it better as per the feedbacks.
ASSEMBLY: Print 1 enclosure, 1 top (left or right), 2 legs and a filler. Depending on left or right, legs go accordingly in the center and one of the side. They have a slight angle, but they can be moved when installed in the bike. The last hole is filled with the filler. The top part can be printed as one with the enclosure if you dont mind supports, or printed separately and glued in. It is the only parts that need to be glued.

description_text:
Take your game or animation to the next level with this uniquely crafted stylized unicycle motorcycle. Designed with precision and personality, this asset blends futuristic flair with playful proportions—perfect for sci-fi, post-apocalyptic, or stylized worlds.
Technical Details  

  - Vertices: 61,391

  - Edges: 122,480

  - Faces: 61,265

  - Triangles: 121,214

  - UVs: Clean, non-overlapping

  - Textures: 4K resolution (BaseColor, Normal, AO, ORM)

  - Format: FBX / OBJ / Blend (choose your preferred format)

  - Ready for: Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender, Maya, 3ds Max

Texture Breakdown  

  - Ambient Occlusion baked for depth

  - ORM map handcrafted in Photoshop for optimal control

  - Stylized materials with subtle wear and edge highlights

  - PBR workflow compatible

Use Cases  

  - Game environments (stylized, sci-fi, cyberpunk)

  - Animation scenes

  - Concept art and cinematic renders

  - Kitbash packs or modular vehicle systems

Included Files  

  - Model (.fbx/.obj/.blend)

  - Textures (PNG, 4K)

  - Preview renders (wireframe + beauty shots)

Key Features at a Glance

  -  Stylized Design Language: A unique blend of cartoonish proportions and sci-fi mechanics, perfect for worlds that don’t play by the rules.

  -  Game-Ready & Optimized: Clean topology, non-overlapping UVs, and PBR-ready textures ensure seamless integration into your pipeline.

  -  Multi-Engine Support: Fully compatible with Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender, Maya, and 3ds Max—no conversions needed.

  -  Flexible File Formats: Comes in .FBX, .OBJ, and .BLEND formats for maximum adaptability.

  -  4K Texture Maps: High-resolution textures (BaseColor, Normal, AO, ORM) for crisp, detailed visuals even in close-up shots.

  -  Stylized PBR Materials: Hand-painted details, edge highlights, and subtle wear bring the model to life with personality and depth.

  -  Modular & Kitbash-Friendly: Use it as a standalone hero asset or break it down into parts for your own custom vehicles.

This asset is textured using a stylized PBR workflow, balancing hand-painted charm with technical precision:

  -  BaseColor: Rich color palette with stylized gradients and hand-painted accents

  -  Normal Map: Sculpted details baked for depth and realism without bloating polycount

  -  Ambient Occlusion: Baked AO adds grounded shadows and enhances visual layering

  -  ORM Map: Custom-built in Photoshop for precise control over Occlusion, Roughness, and Metallic channels

  -  Edge Highlights & Wear: Subtle edge wear and grime for storytelling and visual interest

  -  Material IDs: Organized for easy shader tweaking and material swapping

Ideal Use Cases
This asset is designed to be versatile, modular, and expressive, making it a perfect fit for:

  -  Stylized Game Worlds: From cyberpunk alleys to post-apocalyptic wastelands

  -  Animated Shorts & Cinematics: Add flair and uniqueness to your scenes

  -  Concept Art & Worldbuilding: Use as a visual anchor or narrative prop

  -  Kitbash Libraries: Break it down into parts—handlebars, engine, wheel, seat—for your own creations

  -  Prototyping & Previz: Drop it into your scene to test scale, mood, or motion

Creative Inspiration
Imagine this unicycle motorcycle zipping through:

  - A neon-lit cyberpunk megacity, dodging drones and neon billboards

  - A dusty post-apocalyptic desert, scavenging for parts and glory

  - A whimsical steampunk carnival, where every vehicle has a story

  - A futuristic racing game, where physics take a backseat to fun

This asset isn’t just a tool—it’s a launchpad for storytelling.
Artist’s Note
Crafted with love, grit, and a dash of madness, this unicycle motorcycle was born from a desire to break the mold of traditional vehicle design. It’s a tribute to the weird, the wonderful, and the wildly imaginative. Every bolt, curve, and scratch tells a story—waiting for you to finish it.
Step into a world of bold design and imaginative storytelling with this stylized unicycle motorcycle—a one-wheeled marvel that defies convention and injects personality into any digital universe. Whether you're building a dystopian cityscape, a quirky sci-fi adventure, or a stylized racing game, this asset delivers visual impact, technical polish, and creative flexibility.
Why This Asset Stands OutThis isn’t just a model—it’s a character. With exaggerated proportions, sleek curves, and a touch of mechanical whimsy, the unicycle motorcycle feels alive. It’s designed to spark curiosity, fuel narrative, and elevate the aesthetic of your game or animation.
From the clean topology to the handcrafted texture maps, every detail has been carefully considered to ensure seamless integration into your pipeline—whether you're working in Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender, Maya, or 3ds Max.
What You Get

  -  3D Model in .FBX, .OBJ, and .BLEND formats

  -  4K Texture Maps (BaseColor, Normal, AO, ORM) in PNG

  -  Preview Renders (wireframe + beauty shots) for portfolio or marketplace display

  -  Clean folder structure and naming conventions for easy integration

Gary Yates

description_text:
Billaragage est un jeu de billard avec des gages .
 Inclus : queue de billard x 2 , triangle pour placer les boules , table en 4 parties  ( 220 mm x 140 mm environ assemblée ) , support table en 4 parties .
    Règles du jeu :
  - 1 boule blanche , 1 boule noir  + 14 numérotée .
  - 14 boules , 14 gages , 7 boules par équipes ( peut se jouer à 2 joueurs ) . - Chaque équipe inscrit ses 7 gages sur une feuille de papier ( sans les montrer bien évidemment à l'équipe adverse ) . -L'équipe qui rentre une de ses boules , inflige le gage correspondant au numéro indiqué sur la boule à l'équipe adverse . -Si le joueur rentre une boule de l'autre équipe , il se doit de faire le gage de l'équipe adverse correspondant au numéro .- la boule noir est un joker , elle permet d'éliminer un gage au hasard de l'équipe adverse mais elle doit être rentrée en faisant une bande soit avec la noir ou avec la blanche , mais ne doit pas être rentrée directement , sinon l'équipe perd un gage et passe un tour (l'équipe adverse joue deux fois). -la boule blanche sert à rentrer les autres dans les trous , mais si un joueur la rentre au cour de la partie , il devra passer son tour (l'équipe adverse joue deux fois). -le jeu se termine lorsque une équipe a rentrée toutes ses boules numérotée , ainsi que la boule noir comme indiqué dans les règles .
 Ce jeu peut se jouer en famille , avec des amis ou tout simplement en couple avec des gages coquins pour des soirées câlines .
*** Attention certain fichiers en double sont à inverser avant tranchage et un fichier exemple sans support a été rajouté pour la partie 2 en vue d'enlever les supports de 0.5 mm du support ( part 2 ) mais il  est tout à fait utilisable pour l'impression .*** 
Billaragage is a pool game with pledges.
 Included: pool 2 x tail triangle to place the balls, table 4 parts (220 mm x 140 mm Meeting), 4-part support table.
    Rules of the game :
  - 1 white ball, 1 black ball numbered 14 +.
  - 14 balls, 14 pledges, 7 balls per team (can be played by 2 players). - Each team registered its seven pledges on a sheet of paper (obviously without showing them to the opposing team). -L'équipe Who returns one of his balls, inflicts the guarantee corresponding to the number on the ball to the opposing team. -If The player returns a ball to the other team, he must make the pledge of the opposing team corresponding to the number.- The black ball is wild, it eliminates a token at random from the opposing team but must be returned by a band with either black or with white, but should not be returned directly, otherwise The team loses a token and passes a turn (the opposing team plays twice). -the white ball used to go in the other holes, but if a player returns to the part of the court, he must pass his turn (the opposing team plays twice). -The game ends when a team has returned all numbered balls and the black ball as stated in the rules.
 This game can be played with family, friends or just a couple of rascals with pledges to spend cozy evenings.
*** Please note some duplicate files are to reverse before slicing and a file without such support has been added for Part 2 in order to remove the supports of 0.5 mm from the support (part 2) but it is quite usable for the impression .***

description_text:
DVI-I dual link panel mount female connector 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 4698 vertices, 4752 quad faces (9504 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

USB cable with USB A and MINI USB plugs 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 13726 vertices, 13614 quad faces (27228 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
GNS 430W is an all-in-one GPS/Nav/Comm solution that features a WAAS-certified GPS, 2280-channel capacity comm and 200-channel ILS/VOR with localizer and glideslope. High-speed 5 Hz processing makes navigation calculations and map redraw rates 5 times faster than earlier GNS series navigators. When installed alongside GTN series avionics, the GNS 430W can automatically receive flight plans from the touchscreen device. They can also share user waypoints with each other.
This model is suitable for using in the 3D renderings of architectural visualizations, traffic simulation, games etc. where it doesn't need to use heavy high-polygonal models.

description_text:
Box/case with rotating lid.
Usually prints with movable parts require separate objects to be printed and glued or locked together.This design allows for interlocked parts from different objects to be printed together in the same print!
The hinges have ample space between them and generate a very small amount of supports, the rotation is ensured by the direction which the pivots are pointing at. Just remove visible supports, apply a tiny force on the lid to free it from residual material and voilà: the box is ready!
In addition to the care put into the design and tests performed, the print requires very little material and is very fast(18g and 2 hours on test prints)
EDIT: added a smaller version, useful for rings and small trinkets
Dimensions (regular): 50 x 55 x 79 mm
Dimensions (small): 40 x 36 x 18 mm
Test printed on Zortrax M200
